Prevention: Collecting, burning and burying of plant residues in garden during the winter.
Plough and shovel the earth around the trees in winter
Collection and burning of fallen leaves in spring as they may contain the insect
Keep trees well irrigated to reduce the chance of mite infestation
Monitoring: The plant mite will be widespread, when the temperature be 28-35ºC Regular monitoring in the end of spring and beginning of summer
Mites can be seen in both sides of leaves.
Infected trees are covered with webbing.
Farmers shake webbing cover leaves on a sheet of white paper, then they can see the mites.
When the mite population reach 4-15/ leaf, the controlling program must start.
Direct Control: Washing of tree by water or water spray.
Washing of trees with soap powder (2.5gr/liter).
Kg of onion and take the extract by filtering.
Add the onion extract in 15 litres of water and spray on infected trees.
Use winter oil during the dormant period
Restrictions: Use protective clothing when spraying to protect your eyes, mouth and skin
Buy chemicals from a certified dealer and keep them out of the reach of children
Do not eat, drink or smoke during the spray
Bromopropylate (Neuron) at the rate of 1 ml/ litre
Apply acaricides only once, when the mite population increases.
Wash the trees with water spray one week after application.
Do not eat the fruits for 15-20 days after pesticide applications.
